title: SC Wharf - Water Processing in Lab
author: Kendra Negrey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rxkd7kw

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary solution for processing.

substeps.instruction: Mix 45mL of 80% EtOH with 5mL of 25X SET

steps.title: Prepare Water Samples
steps.instruction: Ensure the sample is well mixed before pouring out of the bottle and before sampling out of the tri-pour.

steps.title: Process DNA Filters
steps.instruction: Filter whole water for DNA analysis and store.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 mL whole water to bottle #1
Filter whole water through a 0.2 um poretics filter
Place filter into the bead beater vial
Store DNA filters in -80°C freezer (Box label - KUDELA SCW DNA#)

steps.title: Process DAP Filters
steps.instruction: Filter whole water for DAP analysis and store.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 mL whole water (WW) to PC bottles
Filter WW through a GF/f filter
Collect filtrate from bottle #4 in a coated glass filter flask (both acid washed beforehand)
Place each filter into a cryovial or plastic tube (one filter per vial)
Store DAP filters in -80°C freezer (Box label - KUDELA SCW DAP#)

steps.title: Process Chlorophyll Samples
steps.instruction: Filter whole water for chlorophyll analysis and preserve with acetone.

substeps.instruction: Filter 25 mL whole water through a GF/f (perform twice on separate filters)
Filter 25 mL whole water through a 10um PC (perform twice on separate filters)
Place each filter into a glass chl tube
Add 7 mL of 90% acetone to each tube
Store in Kudela Lab freezer (-20°C) and run samples within 24 hrs

steps.title: Collect Filtrate for Nutrients
steps.instruction: Collect and store filtrate for Ammonium, Urea, and Nutrients analysis.

substeps.instruction: Fill one 50mL tube with 25 mL of filtrate (Ammonium)
Fill one 50mL tube with 20 mL of filtrate (Urea)
Rinse a plastic scintillation vial with filtrate 3 times
After the 3rd rinse, fill the vial with ~20 mL of filtrate (Nutrients)
Store in Kudela Lab freezer (-20°C)

steps.title: Process Filtrate Aliquots
steps.instruction: Prepare filtrate aliquots for storage or immediate processing.

substeps.instruction: Pour 1.8 mL into a cryovial
Process same day or store at -80°C

steps.title: Preserve Whole Water Samples
steps.instruction: Preserve whole water samples using formaldehyde and Lugols solution.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 100 mL WW into each French square bottle
Add 10 mL of 37% formaldehyde to one (FORM)
Add 2 mL of acid Lugols to the other (LUGOLS)
Store in cold room (Box labels - KUDELA SCW WW FORM and KUDELA SCW WW LUGOLS)
Add 2 drops of 4% paraformaldehyde
Store in -80°C freezer (Box label - KUDELA SCW Bacteria/FCM#)

steps.title: Process Net Tow Samples
steps.instruction: Preserve net tow samples using paraformaldehyde and CDPH bottles.

substeps.instruction: Pipet 16 mL of the net tow into the glass scintillation vial
Add 4 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde
Store in cold room (Flat label - KUDELA SCW NET PARAFORM archive)
Add 100 mL of net tow to the pre-charged CDPH bottle
Label with lab tape and leave in D436 fume hood

steps.title: Safety Precautions
steps.instruction: Maintain safety standards when handling preservatives.

substeps.instruction: Wear gloves and work under fume hood (D436) when working with preservative
